description: This file defines a class WebAutomation that provides helper methods to interact with a WebView login form, including initialization, filling form fields, detecting captcha presence, and submitting the form.

classes.name: WebAutomation
classes.description: A utility class to automate interactions with a WebView login form in a web application, primarily through JavaScript execution.

methods.name: WebAutomation
methods.description: Constructor for WebAutomation, likely for initializing necessary setup.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes resources necessary for web automation.

methods.name: fillFields
methods.description: Fills in username and password fields in the web login form.

methods.name: detectCaptcha
methods.description: Detects whether a captcha is present on the web page.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Submits the login form via JavaScript execution.
